title: Container
subtitle: Zoomed into 3 Business Contexts · All Containers Opened Up
description: Zoomed-In Business Context: upper-layer business contexts open up with transparent borders to reveal all application, API, and database containers inside.
note: Upper-layer Business Context nodes are carried forward as transparent dashed boundaries so you can see which business domain each container serves.

boundaries.label: Omnichannel Digital Banking Context
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Business Context (Zoomed In) · Web, SPA & Mobile
boundaries.description: Delivers self-service web and mobile customer experiences for account dashboards and payment initiation.

boundaries.label: Account, Payment & Security API Context
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Business Context (Zoomed In) · Core Banking API
boundaries.description: Governs sign-in authentication, account summary aggregation, payment orchestration, and mainframe integration.

boundaries.label: Customer Identity & Audit Store Context
boundaries.subtitle: Upper Layer: Business Context (Zoomed In) · Relational Store
boundaries.description: Persists customer registration records, hashed credentials, role entitlements, and security access audit logs.
